title: Add interactive JSON schema playground with live preview
body:
Adds `/playground` route for real-time JSON schema editing and component preview to help users learn the ObjectUI schema format.

## Implementation

**Core functionality:**
- Monaco editor with JSON validation and auto-formatting
- Live `SchemaRenderer` preview synchronized with editor state
- Four example schemas (basic, form, dashboard, list) demonstrating common patterns
- Theme-aware editor using `prefers-color-scheme` media query

**Integration:**
- New route at `/apps/site/app/playground/page.tsx`
- Navigation links added to site header and homepage CTA
- Wrapped in `ObjectUIProvider` for component registration
- Dynamic Monaco import to avoid SSR hydration issues

**Example schema format:**
```json
{
  "type": "div",
  "className": "space-y-4",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "text",
      "content": "Welcome to ObjectUI",
      "className": "text-2xl font-bold"
    },
    {
      "type": "button",
      "variant": "default",
      "label": "Click me"
    }
  ]
}
```
